title: Weeknight Molten Italian Steak Pasta
description: A bitter, molten, weeknight Italian dish featuring lean minced steak, mushroom steam, and a raw-friendly vessel, a fondue pot.

ingredients.name: Lean minced steak
ingredients.notes: 80/20 lean to fat ratio works best

instructions: Combine penne pasta, mushrooms, white wine, and chicken broth in a fondue pot over medium heat.
Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the minced steak to the fondue pot and stir to break up with a spatula.
Cook the steak until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the butter to the fondue pot and stir until melted.
Stir in the Parmesan cheese until melted and smooth.
Season the pasta mixture with salt, black pepper, and garlic to taste.
Stir in the fresh parsley and olive oil.
Serve immediately, directly from the fondue pot.
Be careful, as the cheese and pasta can be very hot.
Serve with additional Parmesan cheese on the side, if desired.
